fixtures.provenance: Synthetic v1, printed English. Rendered offline via ImageMagick 7.1.2 on darwin-arm64; canonical bytes committed. CI never regenerates. Smoke fixture only — excluded from the ε verdict corpus.

render.notes: Rendered with ImageMagick 7.1.2-19 on macOS. Tesseract 5.5.2 (eng) reads this image verbatim as 'hello bakeoff' — CER = 0 against the authored source phrase.

fixtures.notes: First synthetic fixture; verifies the Tesseract harness end-to-end. The Chinese verdict corpus (≥5 active synthetic + ≥2 active real, per Q3 sign-off) is built in γ/δ once tesseract-lang / PaddleOCR / RapidOCR are in scope.

fixtures.reason: α ships engine-free; Chinese verdict fixtures land in γ/δ. Tesseract baseline (β) uses an English smoke fixture (01-hello-bakeoff) because chi_sim isn't installed locally (`brew install tesseract-lang` required for Chinese coverage).
fixtures.notes: Slot reserved. Per Q3 sign-off the bakeoff verdict (ε) requires ≥5 active synthetic + ≥2 active real Chinese-pleading fixtures; γ/δ earn them once the respective engines + language packs are in scope.
